The interns will be selected by a committee appointed by the Hon'ble Chairperson. Criteria for selection would be (1) the course pursued, and (2) academic performance.

title: Police Medal for Meritorious Service
text:
Brief Description:
Under this scheme, medals, official recognition, and service distinction are provided to the personnel serving in police, CAPFs, CPOs, and other public safety organizations.

Detailed Description:
The “Police Medal for Meritorious Service (PM)” scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, under Police-I Division. The scheme aims to recognize consistent meritorious service, professional excellence, and dedication to duty among police and allied forces. Under this scheme, medals, official recognition, and service distinction are provided to eligible personnel serving in police, CAPFs, CPOs, and other public safety organizations.

Eligibility:
The applicant should be a serving police officer or personnel of CAPFs/CPOs.
The applicant should have a clean service record without major penalties.
The applicant should demonstrate meritorious and consistent service.
The applicant should have a minimum service of 18 years.
The applicant should have ACRs available for the last 10 years.
The applicant should have at least 8 Very Good or above ACRs; at least 1 should be Outstanding.
The applicant should not have any average ACR during the review period.
The applicant should have at least 1 ACR after the Non-Initiation Certificate (NIC) period (if applicable).
The applicant should not have more than 1 missing ACR.
The applicant should ensure the last year ACR is available.
The applicant should be physically fit and fall under SHAPE 1 category; relaxation to SHAPE 2 may be given in exceptional cases.
The applicant should not have more than 3 nominations (for Group A officers).
The applicant should not have adverse vigilance or disciplinary issues.

Benefits:
Tangible Benefits
Award of Police Medal for Meritorious Service.
National recognition and prestige.
Entry of award in official service records.
Enhanced career prospects and credibility.
Recognition of long-term service excellence.
Mode of Disbursement
Physical medal and citation conferred by the competent authority.
Awarded annually on national occasions.

Application Process:
Application Process
Step 01:
Visit the National Awards Portal:
https://www.awards.gov.in.
Step 02:
Register/Login using the official credentials of the recommending authority.
Step 03:
Fill in the nomination form with complete details.
Step 04:
Preparation of nomination proposal is done with complete service records and ACR/APAR details.
Step 05:
Upload required documents and the submission of recommendation is made by State Government or Central Organization.
Post-Application Process
Step 01:
Verification of ACR/APAR, vigilance, and service records is conducted thoroughly.
Step 02:
Screening and evaluation are undertaken by committees constituted under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
Step 03:
Final recommendation is prepared based on merit and eligibility conditions.
Step 04:
Approval is granted by the competent authority and the President of India after due consideration.
Step 05:
Announcement and conferment of the award are carried out on national occasions, where the medal and citation are formally presented to the selected awardees.
Provision for Preparation of Duplicate Medal (In Case of Loss)
In exceptional cases, a duplicate medal shall be prepared only once.
Step 01:
The applicant should submit a copy of FIR for loss of medal with full justification through proper channel.
Step 02:
The cost of preparation shall be paid by the individual awardee through Bank Draft as suggested by India Government Mint.
Step 03:
A penalty of ₹10,000 (Rupees Ten Thousand only) shall be paid by the individual in favour of Pay and Accounts Officer, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, through Demand Draft.
Step 04:
The duplicate medal will be issued only after verification and payment confirmation.

title: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
text:
Brief Description:
The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar (RKVP) aims to honor scientists and technical experts for outstanding contributions and innovations in agriculture and allied sciences.

Detailed Description:
The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar under Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR),Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, recognizes and honors scientists and technical personnel who have made outstanding contributions in agriculture, agricultural education, extension, and allied sciences. This includes the development of new processes, products, tools, technologies, and innovative practices that enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability in India.
Fields Covered:
The awards are categorized under three main streams, each covering the following four fields:
Crops & Horticultural Sciences
Natural Resources Management & Agricultural Engineering
Animal & Fisheries Sciences
Social Sciences
Award Categories & Number of Awardees:
Innovation & Technology in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
Research in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
Outstanding Interdisciplinary Team Research in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee
Outstanding Woman Scientist in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee
Outstanding Young Scientist in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees

Eligibility:
General Conditions:
The applicant should be an Indian scientist working in agriculture or allied fields in ICAR institutes, public agricultural institutions, or Krishi Vigyan Kendras, and must have made significant contributions in India.
The applicant should have work (research, innovation, or extension) that shows clear and proven impact on society, economy, or environment, supported by the Head of the Institution.
The applicant can apply at any stage of their career, as no minimum service period is required.
The applicant should submit only one application for a particular contribution in a year, and the application will be valid only for that year.
The applicant should have a clean service record, with no pending enquiry or major punishment in the last five years.
The applicant should apply under only one category and cannot be considered for multiple categories.
Category-wise Conditions:
The applicant can apply individually or as part of a team (maximum five members) for innovation and research awards, and must be below 60 years of age.
The applicant applying for interdisciplinary research should be part of a team of at least three members from different disciplines, and the team leader must be below 60 years of age.
The applicant applying for the women scientist category should be a woman working in agriculture or allied fields, and must be below 60 years of age.
The applicant applying for the young scientist category should have a doctoral degree, hold a regular position, and must be below 45 years of age.

Benefits:
i. In the Award Ceremony, the Awardees shall be presented a Sanad (certificate) signed by the Hon'ble Union Minister (Agriculture & Farmers Welfare) & President, ICAR. A commemorative brochure, containing the citation and photograph of the awardees shall also be released on the day of the ceremony.
ii. The decoration to such persons who are not able to attend the award ceremony due to personal reasons (including indisposition, preoccupation, etc.) shall be deemed to have been conferred. No other person (including the spouse/next of kin) should be allowed to receive the award on behalf of the absentee awardee except in posthumous cases.

title: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme aims to promote innovations in individuals, start-ups, and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (PRISM). It offers financial support (up to ₹20,00,000/-) for Indian Citizens working on innovation projects requiring fabrication of working models, patenting, or technology transfer.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Promoting Innovations In Individuals, Start-Ups And Micro, Small And Medium Enterprises (PRISM)" was launched by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. The scheme aims to promote innovations in individuals, start-ups and micro, small and medium enterprises. The scheme provides support for Individual Innovator Proposals under Phase-I, Category II, focusing on Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer. Key features include comparatively more rigorous demonstrability of original idea/invention/know-how in the form of working prototype/processes and its testing and trial/patenting/technology transfer. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR). The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs) or directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research.

Eligibility:
The applicant must be an Indian Citizen.
The applicant must have an innovative idea or an invention.
The applicant must propose a project where the project cost is more than ₹5,00,000/- and up to ₹35,00,000/-.
The applicant must ensure the project duration does not exceed 24 months.
The applicant must ensure the proposal involves the fabrication of a working model/process know-how/testing and trial/patenting/technology transfer.
The applicant must ensure the proposal does not involve only software development.
The applicant must ensure the proposal is not for basic scientific research having no immediate commercial implications.
Specific Conditions
Students:
The applicant must provide a `No Objection Certificate’ from the head of their institution on the institution’s letterhead.
Students:
The applicant must ensure the commitment from the institution that the project will be taken to its logical conclusion by the student/concerned faculty.
Individuals Working in Organizations:
The applicant must furnish a `No Objection Certificate’ from their employer.
Desirable Criteria (Preference)
The proposals should preferably be in the following focus sectors: Green Technology, Clean Energy, Industrially utilizable smart materials, Waste to wealth, Affordable healthcare, Water & sewage management, or any other technology or knowledge-intensive area.
Preference: Student innovators making it to the final of any competition are eligible, but they should take the project as a full-time activity after graduation to ensure their studies are not adversely affected.
The applicant should ensure the proposal is submitted through the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre, even if scouted, documented, and mentored by other agencies, and must include evaluation by the assisting agency.

Benefits:
The maximum support under Category II is ₹20,00,000/- or 90% of the approved project cost, whichever is lower. The approved project cost must be more than ₹5,00,000/- and up to ₹35,00,000/-.
Eligible Components for Support
Research and Development/Design Engineering/Consultancy charges.
Rental charges for laboratory/workshop facilities.
Essential equipment that cannot be taken on rent (reasons for purchase must be given).
Raw material/spares/consumables cost.
Fabrication/synthesis charges.
Manpower cost of technical assistants, not exceeding 20% of the approved project cost.
Testing and trials.
Travel cost, not exceeding 5% of the approved project cost.
Patent filing (actual fee paid to the patent office).
Process know-how development.
Proposals involving scientifically characterizing or testing the efficacy and toxicity of herbal formulations.
Exclusions from Support
Innovator’s salary.
Rental expenses for use of own facilities.
Disbursement
The first release is based on milestones/deliverables projected in the project proposals and as recommended by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC).
Subsequent releases are based on the assessment of the progress of the project by the Project Review Committee (PRC).
Conditions
The applicant has to sign "Terms & Conditions" prior to the actual release of grants-in-aid.
The approved projects will be monitored by the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre/other network partners, including technical expert(s).
The TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres will be periodically reporting project status to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research at an interval of 3 months.
The Project Review Committees, consisting of external experts, will meet at least once in nine months to review the progress of the project.
For student innovators, the institution will be responsible for final completion of the project in case the Innovator leaves the Institute/Organization without completion of the project.

Application Process:
Proposals can be submitted to the following -
The nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs).
The Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
Step 1:
Consultation and Preparation
The innovator should meet coordinators of TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs) and take their advice before submitting the application.
The applicant must prepare the
application form
, ensuring all mandatory details like the Title of the proposed project, Name, Address, Date of Birth, Educational qualification, Annual Income, Permanent Account Number (PAN) (mandatory), and Aadhaar Number are included.
Step 2:
Submission of Proposal
The applicant must submit the application either directly to the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre (TOCIC) or directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
Proposals submitted directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research will be forwarded to the relevant TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre for counselling and local screening.
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
Initial Screening for Completeness
The proposals will initially be screened for completeness at the point of receipt by the coordinators of the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres.
Step 2:
Evaluation by Domain Knowledge Experts
After initial Screening, the complete and screened proposals are evaluated by the Domain Knowledge Experts associated with the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre.
Step 3:
Submission to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research
The TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres will send complete and evaluated proposals to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research for further action.
Step 4:
Committee Recommendation
The proposals will then be considered by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC) for final recommendation.
Step 5:
Final Approval and Sanction
The sanction will finally be released to those projects that are approved by the Department.
Step 6:
Signing of Terms and Conditions
The applicant has to sign the "Terms & Conditions" document prior to the actual release of the grants-in-aid.
Disbursement
Step 1:
First Release
The first release of funds is based on milestones and deliverables projected in the project proposals and as recommended by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC).
Step 2:
Subsequent Fund Release and Monitoring
Subsequent releases of funds are based on the assessment of the progress of the project by the Project Review Committee (PRC). The approved projects will be monitored by the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre/other network partners, including technical expert(s), and the Project Review Committees will meet at least once in nine months to review the progress of the project.
Step 3:
Project Closure
The project completion report will be accepted by the Competent Authority in the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, based on the Project Review Committee recommendation, after the successful closure of the project.

title: Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by Science & Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate mobility of faculty members working in State Universities /Colleges/Private Academic institutions.

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate the mobility of faculty members working in a regular capacity in State Universities / Colleges and in private Academic Institutions to carry out research work in an established public-funded central institution such as IITs, IISc, IISERS, National Institutions (NITs, CSIR, ICAR, ICMR labs and other central institutions) and Central Universities, located preferably nearer to the institution where the faculty member is working. Research work will be carried out in such a manner to ensure that the PI continues to work in the host institute as well as his / her parent institute on mutually agreed terms between the PI and Mentor.
Areas Covered under the scheme:
The scheme covers areas under Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, and Mathematical Sciences, including interdisciplinary areas.
Duration of Support:
The duration of support is three years.

Eligibility:
Indian citizens residing in India holding a Ph.D. degree in Science/Engineering or MS/MD in Medicine are eligible to apply.
The applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in State Universities/ Colleges and private Academic Institutions.
Applicant should not hold any ongoing research projects or any fellowship at the time of submission of application.
The upper age limit for the award is 45 years at the time of the submission of the application. Age relaxation of 5 (five) years will be given to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates.
Mentor should be at the level of Associate Professor/Scientist E, or higher level.
Only one candidate will be allowed to work with a mentor at any given point of time.

Benefits:
Research fellowship of ₹60,000/- per year (in addition to the researcher’s own salary) will be provided subject to completion of a minimum of 90 days of research work per year in the host institution.
Research grant of ₹5 lakhs per annum (50% each to host and parent institution) and overheads (as per SERB norms) will be provided.

The call for proposals will be notified through the website
www.serbonline.in
and
www.serb.gov.in

Other relevant information of the proposal must be uploaded in a single PDF file not more than 10 MB as other technical documents (OTD).

title: Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences

The program must involve a minimum 5 speakers.

Up to ₹50,000/- or 75% of the actual expenditure, whichever is lower, is provided for organizing approved literary or educational events.

An honorarium of up to ₹2,000/- per speaker can be paid to invited speakers participating in the event.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Loan for Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide students belonging to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.) with financial assistance for higher education abroad. The scheme provides a maximum loan of ₹15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh) for higher studies in foreign countries. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the official website
https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/

title: Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in sericulture and weaving by providing financial support. It also focuses on strengthening Eri and Muga silk production and promoting Meghalaya’s yarn and fabric in national and global markets.

Detailed Description:
The
Meghalaya Sericulture and Weaving Scheme
, implemented by the Department of Textiles under the Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department of the Government of Meghalaya, is a credit-linked scheme that provides up to 75% financial assistance on the total project cost to support entrepreneurs and collectives in starting sericulture and weaving activities. The scheme focuses mainly on Eri silk, a traditional and exclusive fabric of Meghalaya, and also supports Muga silk due to the state’s favorable climate. It aims to promote the silk industry by helping set up grainages for producing Disease-Free Layings (DFL), spinning or reeling and natural dyeing units, and weaving units, thereby unlocking entrepreneurial potential and placing Meghalaya yarn and fabric on the international silk map.

Eligibility:
For Collectives (Registered & Unregistered Entities):
The collective must be based in the village where the program is being implemented.
The registered entity must have at least 10 members.
The collective must have prior experience in spinning and weaving, with a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Officer/District Handloom Officer stating that at least 5 members are spinners, reelers, or weavers, or valid Handloom ID cards for at least 5 weavers issued by the Government of Meghalaya.
The collective should employ a minimum of 5 spinners or weavers, supported by an undertaking.
The collective applying for Grainage must have staff with a minimum educational qualification of 10th pass and a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Office confirming at least 2 years of experience in the production of layings.
The collective must have an active bank account and submit bank statements for the last 6 months.
The collective must have been operating for at least two years.
The collective must possess land, either self-owned or leased, verified by the competent authority.
For Individuals:
The individual must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
The individual must have completed training in spinning or weaving, supported by a certificate from a registered training provider, a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Officer/District Handloom Officer, or a valid Handloom ID issued by the Government of Meghalaya.

title: Swayam Saksham Yojana (GBCDC)
text:
Brief Description:
This scheme aims to instill a sense of self-reliance in the youth belonging to backward classes after receiving vocational education/training. Under this scheme, eligible youth are provided loans at a low-interest rate to start self-employment ventures.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Swayam Saksham Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to inculcate the spirit of self-reliance among socially and educationally backward class youth who have received vocational or professional training. Under this scheme, low-interest loans are provided to educated unemployed youth for setting up self-employment ventures like clinics, law offices, engineering units, and more. The initiative focuses on empowering beneficiaries to start independent businesses with financial assistance, promoting economic inclusion and entrepreneurship.

Eligibility:
The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC).
The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age on the date of application.
The applicant should be unemployed but professionally educated (e.g., doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA, etc.).
The total annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
The applicant should have completed a professional course (degree or diploma).
The applicant should intend to start a professional business such as clinics, nursing homes, physiotherapy clinics, biomedical labs, legal offices, medical stores, architect offices, engineering units, C.A. offices, etc.

Benefits:
Loan Amount:
Up to ₹5,00,000/- per applicant.
Interest Rate:
6% per annum.
Loan Share:
Under the scheme, the loan will be distributed in a unit cost ratio where-
85% will be covered by a national corporation
10% by State Government
5% contribution by the beneficiary
Repayment Terms:
This loan will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments including interest.

text:
Brief Description:
The scheme boosts tourism by providing 50% financial assistance for adventure tourism vehicles, along with easy credit, operator training, and GPS and branding support.

Detailed Description:
The
PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme
, implemented by the Tourism Department under the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program of the Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department, Government of Meghalaya, aims to boost tourism in the state by providing 50% financial assistance for the purchase of adventure tourism vehicles. The scheme also offers easy credit through partner banks, training for operators, and government-funded GPS and branding support, thereby enabling entrepreneurs and entities to enhance tourist transport services and promote economic growth.

Eligibility:
Individuals
The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age.
The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license.
The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector.
The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle.
The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.
Registered Entities
The applicant should be a recognised and registered tour operator, tourism society, or similar entity based in Meghalaya.
The applicant should have experience in the tourism sector.
The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle.
The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme.
The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.
The applicant should provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate, as applicable.
Unregistered Entities
The applicant should be an unregistered entity such as a village organization, self-help group, or traditional community based in Meghalaya.
The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector.
The applicant should provide certification from the Block Development Officer (BDO) to support involvement in the tourism sector.
The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme.
The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.

Benefits:
50% of on-road vehicle cost supported (5% by the entrepreneur, 45% by the Government of Meghalaya)
5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months
Credit linkage through partnered banks
Pre-fitted GPS device with 5-year warranty (cost borne by Government, one-time)
Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government (first time only)
Mandatory capacity building and training programs under Meghalaya Tourist Operator Program (MTOTP) by the Tourism Department
Support from PRIME – Tourism Vehicle Cell for promotion, grievance redressal, and training
Eligibility for multiple vehicle types, including 8–17 seater luxury buses, 4x4 vehicles, and MPVs for tourism and adventure tourism

title: Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS)
text:
Brief Description:
The objective of this scheme is to empower young people and youth organisations by providing financial support for development activities. It aims to encourage youth participation in community service, sports, cultural events, and leadership initiatives across Meghalaya.

Detailed Description:
The
Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS Meghalaya)
scheme, under the Department of Sports and Youth Affairs, Government of Meghalaya, provides financial assistance to registered youth organisations and eligible individual youth to carry out activities that promote youth development. The scheme is designed to strengthen networking, collaboration, and meaningful community-level engagement.
Targeted Stakeholders
Financial assistance is extended to the following entities and individuals:
Societies and Cooperatives
Voluntary and Not-for-Profit Organisations
Youth Clubs and Associations
Socio-Cultural Clubs
Alumni Associations
Community-level Youth Institutions or Groups
Individuals selected for competitions or events with valid proof of participation

Eligibility:
For Youth Organisations
The organisation should be a registered society, trust, charitable organisation, Section 8 company, or not-for-profit entity under the Societies Registration Act of 1860 for at least 3 months.
The organisation should maintain financial accounts with a clear framework for effective and transparent management.
The organisation should have primary beneficiaries under the age of 35 and be open to all citizens of the state without distinction of religion, race, caste, or language.
The organisation should have at least 50% of registered members under the age of 35 as of the application date.
The organisation should not be blacklisted or barred by any government or private entity and should have no pending or ongoing litigation related to misconduct, misappropriation of funds, or sexual harassment.
For Individuals
The applicant should be a citizen of Meghalaya and under the age of 35 as of the application date.
The applicant should have a bank account in their name (single or joint account).
The applicant should be able to provide proof of selection for the competition or event for which the grant is being requested.

Benefits:
Financial assistance of up to INR 1.00 lakh per financial year may be sanctioned to eligible youth organisations or individuals.
Up to 10% of the total applications may receive a higher amount of financial support.

title: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Khadi Vikas Yojana" is an umbrella scheme under "Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" and has been implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Governemnt of India. It aims to support Khadi institutions and artisans by providing financial assistance, infrastructure development, interest subsidy, and marketing support. The scheme offers subsidies on Khadi production, reduces the interest burden on bank loans, facilitates the construction of worksheds for artisans, strengthens existing weak Khadi institutions, and enhances marketing infrastructure, including the renovation and modernization of sales outlets. Additionally, the scheme supports quality assurance initiatives, exhibitions, science and technology interventions, and the establishment of Centres of Excellence for Khadi

Eligibility:
The applicant must be a Khadi artisan or Khadi Institution registered with KVIC or KVIB.
The applicant must be between 18 to 55 years of age.
The applicant must have a valid Aadhaar card or government-issued ID.
One person per family is eligible under the scheme.
The applicant should not have availed benefits from any other government scheme for the same purpose.
Preference is given to SC/ST, women, unemployed youth, and BPL category applicants.
The beneficiaries may be identified by KVIC, KVIBs, NGOs, DICs, FPOs, or Khadi Institutions.

Benefits:
Assistance provided under different components of Scheme:
Modified Market Development Assistance (MMDA):
Subsidy @ 35% on Prime Cost for Cotton/Muslin, Wool and Polyvastra and @ 20% on Prime Cost for Silk Khadi
Interest Subsidy Eligibility Certificate Scheme (ISEC):
Khadi Institution is required to pay only 4% interest rate. The difference between the actual Interest charged by the Bank and 4% is borne by the KVIC as “Interest Subsidy”.
Work-shed Scheme for Khadi Artisans:
Individual workshed (20 Sq. mtrs): ₹1,20,000/- or 75% of the cost of workshed including toilet (90% for NER), whichever is less.
Group workshed (10 Sq. mtrs per artisans): ₹80,000 or 75% of the cost of the workshed including toilet (90% for NER), whichever is less.
Strengthening Infrastructure of Existing Weak Khadi Institutions and Assistance for Marketing Infrastructure:
Financial assistance for revival of khadi institution with ceiling limit of ₹15.00 lakh(Capital Expenditure +working fund).
Financial assistance under Marketing Infrastructure for renovation of departmental sales outlets of KVIC /KVIB and institutional sales with the ceiling limit of ₹25.00 lakh.
Other Components:
Centre of Excellence for Khadi
Khadi Quality Assurance
Marketing(Exhibition)
Science & Technology (S&T)

title: Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme provides interest subsidy to the students belonging to the OBCs and EBCs on the interest payable for the period of the moratorium for the Education Loans for overseas studies to pursue approved courses of studies abroad at Masters, M.Phil. and PhD level.

Detailed Description:
"Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)" is an Education Loan Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Implementing Agency
The Scheme will be implemented by the Nodal Bank as per the MoU between the Banks and the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.
Scope
The scheme provides interest subsidy to the students belonging to the OBCs and EBCs on the interest payable for the period of the moratorium for the Education Loans for overseas studies to pursue approved courses of studies abroad at Masters, M.Phil. and PhD level.
Objective
To award interest subsidies to meritorious students belonging to the Other Backward Classes and Economically Backward Classes to provide them with better opportunities for higher education abroad and enhance their employability.

Eligibility:
The applicant should be a Student.
The student should have secured admission in the approved course at Masters, M.Phil or PhD levels abroad for the
listed courses
.
The applicant should have availed loan from a scheduled bank under the Education Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA) for the purpose.
The total income of the applicant (from all sources) shall not exceed ₹ 8,00,000 per annum.
Reservation/ Relaxation/ Preference/ Priority
Out of the total outlay in a year, a minimum of 50% amount will be earmarked for Interest Subsidy to the girl candidates.

Benefits:
Under the scheme, interest payable by the students availing the education loans of the IBA for the period of moratorium (i.e. course period, plus one year or six months after getting a job, whichever is earlier) as prescribed under the Education Loan Scheme of the IBA, shall be borne by the Government of India.
For a student, the eligible loan component shall be the actual loan taken subject to a maximum of ₹ 20,00,000 for the purpose of an Interest subsidy claim.
NOTE 1:
After the period of moratorium is over, the interest on the outstanding loan amount shall be paid by the student, in accordance with the existing Educational Loan Scheme as may be amended from time to time.
NOTE 2:
The candidate will bear the Principal instalments and interest beyond the moratorium period.
Release of Funds
The funds will be released to the applicants on a first-come-first-served basis, subject to a maximum amount to be worked out every year based on the total budget made available that year, under the scheme.

Application Process:
Step 1:
The interest Subsidy shall be linked with the existing Educational Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA) and restricted to students enrolled for courses at Master, M.Phil and PhD levels.
Step 2:
The Nodal Bank will lay down the detailed procedure for processing and sanctioning interest subsidies to eligible students in consultation with the Ministry.
Step 3:
The Recommendatory Committee headed by the Joint Secretary in charge of the Backward Classes Division with representatives of the Finance Division, a representative of Nodal Bank and the concerned Director/Deputy Secretary as convener will examine and recommend the applications for the award of interest subsidy on a quarterly basis.

title: Study in India Programme
text:
Brief Description:
The Study in India Programme aims to promote India as a global education hub by offering centralized admissions, quality education, and visa support to international students.”

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Study in India Programme” has been launched by the Ministry of Education under the Department of Higher Education, Government of India. The scheme aims to position India as a global education destination by providing international students with a single centralized digital platform, access to quality institutions, and end-to-end admission and visa support for pursuing higher education in India.
Scheme Implementation
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education in coordination with the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of External Affairs through the Study in India portal.

Eligibility:
The applicant should be a foreign national seeking admission in India.
The applicant should have completed the required qualifying education as per course norms.
The applicant should apply through the Study in India portal.
The applicant should possess a valid passport.
The applicant should meet academic and language requirements of the chosen institution.
Indian nationals are not eligible under the Study in India Programme.
Admissions outside the Study in India portal are not covered.

Benefits:
Single Centralized Admission Platform:
One portal for registration, course search, application submission, visa and FRRO processes.
Access to Quality Institutions:
Admission to NAAC-accredited, NIRF-ranked, autonomous, and globally ranked institutions.
Unique Study in India Student ID
Mandatory unique ID generated at registration.
Required for admission and visa issuance.
Wide Range of Courses
Access to 8,000+ courses including Engineering, Management, Science, Humanities, Artificial Intelligence, Medicine, Yoga, Buddhist Studies, and Vocational Courses.
Ability to apply to multiple institutions simultaneously and receive multiple offer letters.
Financial Assistance through Institutes
Tuition fee waivers ranging from 10% to 100%, subject to institute discretion.
No direct scholarship is provided by the Study in India Programme.
Visa and Immigration Support
Assistance through coordination with Indian Embassies and High Commissions.
24×7 Student Support
Continuous support through toll-free contact center, email, and social media.

Application Process:

Register Here:
The applicant must register on the
Study in India portal
for the current academic year by creating a user account.
Plan Your Budget:
The applicant should assess and plan the estimated expenditure, including tuition fees, accommodation, living expenses, and other related costs.
Submit Application:
The applicant must select the preferred course and institution and submit the online application through the portal.
Check Result:
The applicant should check the portal for the allotted course and institution based on merit and preferences.
Prepare for Departure:
The applicant should complete admission formalities and begin preparations for travel and study in India.

title: Sukhatme National Award in Statistics
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme aims to recognise excellence in statistical research and official statistics. Through this scheme, national recognition is provided to eligible Indian statisticians for lifetime or young achiever contributions.

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Sukhatme National Award in Statistics” has been implemented by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation, Government of India. It aims to recognise outstanding contributions made by individuals in terms of high-quality research work, to improve the system of official statistics in general, and to develop innovative methods for addressing challenges encountered in sample surveys, data management systems, and data integration, in particular. Through this scheme, national-level recognition in the form of a citation, shawl, and memento is provided to eligible Indian statisticians for lifetime contribution or young achiever excellence.
Ceremony Details
:
The award will be presented on Statistics Day, i.e. on 29th June every year, with an award in each of the two categories being given in alternate years.
At this ceremony, citations highlighting the work of the awardee would be read out.
Awardee may also be requested to take a session highlighting the significance of their work.

Eligibility:
The applicant must be an Indian National without distinction of race, occupation, position and gender.
The applicant should be at least 45 years of age as on 31st December of the financial year in which the award is announced, and is eligible to apply for the said award.
The applicant should not be an official involved in the selection process of the awardees.
The applicant’s family members should also not be part of the selection process of the awardees.

Benefits:
Citation signed by Hon’ble Minister of Statistics & Programme Implementation.
Besides the above, a Shawl and a Memento shall be given to the awardee.
No. of Awardees:
One for the Sukhatme National Award in Statistics for Lifetime Contribution in the Field of Statistics.
One for the C.R. Rao National Award in Statistics for Young Statisticians.
(Note: Among the two categories of the National Award in Statistics, only one award shall be conferred each year on an alternate basis.)

Application Process:
Step 1:
The applicant may apply through self-nomination or institutional nomination. The applicant should visit the official Rashtriya Puraskar (National Awards) Portal at
https://www.awards.gov.in
.
Step 2:
On the award details page, select the "Sukhatme National Award in Statistics" from the award list. The option “Nominate / Apply Now” is displayed at the top. The applicant should click on this option to proceed. A new page opens where the applicant should select “Click here to Register” under the Login to Portal section.
Step 3:
On the registration page, the applicant should select the registration type as Individual or Organisation, as applicable.
Step 4:
The applicant should enter the required personal details, i.e., Your Name, Date of Birth, select Nominator/Applicant Type and Mobile Number, Email ID, Address and Gender. Enter Aadhaar Number. Enter the CAPTCHA displayed on the screen and click on Submit to complete the registration process.
Note:
The applicant should submit the nomination or application along with testimonials from 3 distinguished statisticians or referees through the portal.
Applications for the Sukhatme National Award in Statistics are invited only through the National Awards Portal of the Ministry of Home Affairs at
https://www.awards.gov.in.
Applications submitted through any other mode are not considered.
In posthumous cases, if the person proposed to be honoured has passed away within 1 year, the award may be given posthumously.
Procedure for selection of awardee:
The selection of awardee(s) will be done in four stages, as follows:
Primary Scrutiny by the Subject Matter Division of MoSPI.
Examination by Screening Committee
External Scrutiny Examination
Final Selection of the Nominee by the Award Committee
Approving Authority: Hon’ble Minister of Statistics & Programme Implementation

title: Scheduled Tribe Purvadasham Scholarship Scheme (Class 1 to 8) - Uttarakhand
text:
Brief Description:
The aim of this scheme is to help Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 8th by giving them financial support so they can continue their education without any financial difficulty.

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheduled Tribe Purvadasham Scholarship Scheme (Class 1 to 8)” has been implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students to support their education from Class 1st to Class 8th.

Eligibility:
The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
The applicant must possess a valid caste certificate.
The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school in Uttarakhand.
The applicant must be studying in a Class 1 to 8.
The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class.
The applicant should not be receiving benefits under any other government scholarship scheme.
There is no income limit for this scholarship.

Benefits:
Rate of Scholarship:
Class 1 to 5: ₹600/-
Class 6 to 8: ₹960/-

Application Process:
Students apply online on the Government of India’s National Scholarship Portal (NSP) (
https://scholarships.gov.in
).
The following documents must be attached with the application: the applicant’s Aadhaar card, caste certificate, mobile number, attested photograph, and a CBS bank account that is Aadhaar-linked/seeded; marksheet of the previous class passed; and a self-declaration stating that the applicant is not availing benefits under any other government scholarship scheme.
The student submits the application to their educational institution using their own ID. The concerned educational institution forwards the received online application to the District Social Welfare Officer. The District Social Welfare Officer examines the received applications and conducts physical verification of the complete applications. Incomplete applications that can be corrected are temporarily marked as defective, while those that cannot be corrected are permanently rejected. The eligible applicants receive the scholarship amount directly in their bank accounts, subject to the availability of funds.
Procedure:
Step 1: The student registers and submits the application form online.
Step 2: The educational institution verifies the submitted applications.
Step 3: Physical verification of the students is conducted by the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) and/or a third-party agency appointed by the government.
Step 4: Online verification is completed at the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) level.
Step 5: The scholarship amount is disbursed to the students whose applications are fully verified, through the PFMS (Public Financial Management System).

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Scheduled Tribe Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11)" has been implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.

Eligibility:
The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school/educational institution in Uttarakhand.
The applicant must be studying in Class 11 or higher level course.
The applicant must possess valid documents, such as Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate.
The total annual income of the parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.
The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class.

Benefits:
The total scholarship amount determined by the districts = Educational Allowance + Tuition Fee.
Group 1:
Bachelors, Master’s Degree, M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree, PG Diploma, Professional Courses in various streams-
Hostellers:
₹1,200/- per month; (₹12,000/- per annum)
Day Scholars:
₹550/- monthly; (₹5,500/- per annum)
Group 2:
For all non-professional recognized courses that lead to Graduate, M.Phil/Ph.D. degrees, and which do not fall under Arts, Science and Commerce group, such as: BA/BSc/B.Com or MA/MSc/M.Com:
Hostellers:
₹820/- monthly; (₹8,200/- per annum)
Day Scholar:
₹530/- monthly; (₹5,300/- per annum)
Group 3:
For professional streams, ITI courses, 3-year diploma courses in polytechnic, etc.:
Hostellers:
₹570/- monthly; (₹5,700/- per annum)
Day Scholars:
₹300/- monthly; (₹3,000/- per annum)
Group 4:
All post-matric level non-degree courses for which the entry qualification is high school (10th), for example, Senior Secondary Certificate (Class 11 and 12)
Hostellers:
₹380/- monthly; (₹3,800/- per annum)
Day Scholars:
₹230/- monthly; (₹2,300/- per annum)

Application Process:
Students apply online on the Government of India’s National Scholarship Portal (NSP) (
https://scholarships.gov.in
).
The following documents must be uploaded with the application: Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate.
The student submits the application to their educational institution using their own ID. The concerned educational institution forwards the received online application to the District Social Welfare Officer. The District Social Welfare Officer examines the received applications and conducts physical verification of the complete applications. Incomplete applications that can be corrected are temporarily marked as defective, while those that cannot be corrected are permanently rejected. The eligible applicants receive the scholarship amount directly in their bank accounts, subject to the availability of funds.
Procedure:
Step 1: The student registers and submits the application form online.
Step 2: The educational institution verifies the submitted applications.
Step 3: Physical verification of the students is conducted by the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) and/or a third-party agency appointed by the government.
Step 4: Online verification is completed at the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) level.
Step 5: The scholarship amount is disbursed to the students whose applications are fully verified, through the PFMS (Public Financial Management System).

title: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme aims to provide merit-based financial assistance to children of CM-KISAN beneficiaries pursuing professional and technical courses, supporting higher education through Direct Benefit Transfer.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana" has been implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Empowerment, Government of Odisha. It aims to extend financial assistance to the children of the beneficiaries under CM-KISAN for pursuing Professional/ Technical courses. It will lead to better access to Higher Education for children of Small & Marginal farmers (SF/MF) and Landless Agricultural households (LAH). Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana will support SF/MF & LAH in empowering their families.
Key Features:
In order to ensure proper higher education of their children, support will be provided in the form of Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana. The scholarship will be given purely on a merit basis to those who are studying professional/technical courses like Medical and Engineering. Agriculture & Allied, Nursing, Diploma, and different trades in ITI in Government, Private Institutions, and Premier Institutions.

Eligibility:
The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the State of Odisha.
The applicant should be a child of an eligible beneficiary under the CM-KISAN scheme, including both components, namely Support to Farmers for Cultivation and Livelihood Support to Landless Agricultural Households.
The applicant’s parent must be eligible under CM-KISAN, which will be verified during the student’s application process at the Chief District Agriculture Officer (CDAO) level.
The applicant must have obtained admission on a merit basis in a Government Institution or Private Institution having an AISHE code (All India Survey on Higher Education) of the State, or in a Premier Government Institution, whether located inside or outside the State.
The applicant must have taken admission in any of the following Subjects and courses:
Professional or Technical Undergraduate courses such as M.B.B.S., B.D.S., B.H.M.S., B.A.M.S., B.Pharm, B.Sc. (Nursing), Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, B.Sc. (Hons) Horticulture, B.Sc. (Hons) Forestry, B.Sc. (Fisheries Science), B.Sc. (Community Science), B.Tech (Agricultural Engineering), B.Tech/B.E., B.B.A., B.C.A., and other equivalent courses offered by Government Institutions and Private Institutions having an AISHE code (All India Survey on Higher Education) of the State are covered under the Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana. OR
Professional or Technical Postgraduate courses such as M.Tech, M.Sc. (Agriculture), M.Sc. (Forestry), Postgraduate courses in Medical Science, M.B.A., M.C.A., M.Pharm, and other equivalent courses forming part of a Master’s programme are also included. The maximum duration of scholarship support shall be 2 years for Postgraduate courses and 4 years for Ph.D. courses. Ph.D. courses must be related to the eligible postgraduate courses and must be pursued only in Government Institutions located within the State. OR
Diploma courses such as Diploma in Pharmacy, Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology, Diploma in Medical Radiography Technology, Ophthalmic Assistance or Surgical Ophthalmic Assistance, General Nursing and Midwifery, Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery, Psychiatric Nursing, and other equivalent medical courses recommended by the Directorate of Medical Education and Training, as well as courses offered by Polytechnic and Agricultural Polytechnic Institutions, are also included under the Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana.
The applicant admitted to self-financing courses in Government or Private Institutions shall be eligible for the scholarship only as per the capped fee structure.
The applicant should not be in receipt of any other scholarship. If the applicant is already availing another scholarship, he or she must shift from the existing scholarship scheme to the Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana, if they so choose. Only one scholarship can be availed.
The applicant should apply for only one professional course under this scheme.
The applicant should not avail more than one scholarship for similar courses.
The applicant should not be admitted to a Private Institution located outside the State.

Benefits:
Scholarship Support:
Scholarship is provided to students pursuing eligible professional, technical, diploma, postgraduate, and doctoral courses.
The scholarship is awarded purely on a merit basis.
Course-Based Financial Assistance:
For the students of Government Institutions, the tuition fees, annual fees, one-time fees, hostel charges, and any other fees deposited by the student in the colleges/universities/institutions except the caution money/ any other refundable money as admissible shall be released to the concerned student account.
Scholarship amount for the students studying in Private Institutes of the State shall be released to the student as per the course fee structure enclosed in
Annexure-1
.
Premier Institutions Support:
For students admitted to premier institutions such as National Institute of Technology (NIT), Indian Institute of Technology(NIT), Indian Institute of Management (IIM), All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Indian Council of Agricultural Research institutions (ICAR)( Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI), Central Institute of Fisheries Education (CIFE), and National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI), the scholarship is limited to the lower of actual recommended fees or ₹1,00,000/-.
Hostel and Mess Charges:
₹1,200/- per month for Under Graduate, Post Graduate, Ph.D., and Premier Institution students for 10 months.
₹1,000/- per month for Diploma, Polytechnic, and Industrial Training Institute students for 10 months.

Application Process:
Step 1:
The student must visit the Odisha State Scholarship Portal using the following link:
https://scholarship.odisha.gov.in/website/scholarship-details
Step 2:
On the homepage, locate the top navigation bar. Click on the “Scheme” option.
From the list of available scholarships, identify “Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana”. Click on the “Apply” button shown against the scheme.
Step 3:
After clicking “Apply”, select “Register Now”. You will be redirected to a new registration page, where you will enter the student’s Aadhaar number. Complete Aadhaar authentication (OTP-based verification, as shown in the video)& then create a password and complete the registration process.
Step 4:
After successful registration, return to the scheme page. Click again on “Apply”. Log in using the registered Aadhaar number and the password created during registration.
Step 5:
After logging in, the student must complete the online application form, which includes:
Personal details of the student
Academic details (course, year, institution, admission type)
Parent/Guardian details, including CM-KISAN beneficiary information
Bank account details (student’s own Aadhaar-linked bank account)
Step 6:
Upload scanned copies/photos of the required documents, such as:
Aadhaar Card
Residence Certificate
Caste Certificate (if required)
Passport-sized photograph
Ration Card of the Parent/ guardian
CM-KISAN Beneficiary ID of parent/guardian
Bank Account Details
Institute Declaration Certificate
Matriculation Certificate of the Student
Marksheet of the last exam passed
Step 7:
Carefully review all entered details and uploaded documents. Make corrections if required before final submission. Click on the “Submit” button to complete the application. After submission, keep a copy of the application/acknowledgement for future reference.
Step 8:
The application is forwarded online to the Head of the Institution, who verifies the student's enrollment, course, and institution details & the academic authenticity. Then the Chief District Agriculture Officer (CDAO) verifies the CM-KISAN beneficiary status of the student’s parent/guardian and the eligibility under the scheme guidelines.
Step 9:
Once all verifications are completed, the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Empowerment, Government of Odisha, releases the scholarship amount & the amount is transferred directly to the student’s bank account through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer)
Note:
Physical/offline applications are not accepted.
Only online, verified, and authenticated applications are considered.
Incorrect Aadhaar, bank details, or unverified applications may lead to rejection.
The online application portal opens twice in a year, with the first application window available during July or August and the second during November or December.

title: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance
text:
Brief Description:
The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to the dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs.

Detailed Description:
The “Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance” scheme has been launched by the Department of Culture, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the legal dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs. Under this scheme, one-time ex-gratia financial support is provided to the lawful heir to help the family cope with financial hardship after the death of the artist or litterateur.

Eligibility:
The applicant should be the legal heir or dependent of the deceased artist or litterateur.
The deceased should have been an artist or litterateur of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant’s (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed ₹10,000/-.
The family’s monthly income should not exceed ₹20,000/-.
Families of government employees are not eligible.

Benefits:
One-time ex-gratia financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 paid to the legal heir of the deceased artist or litterateur.
NOTE:
Preference is given to the spouse of the deceased.
Assistance may continue to other dependents until marriage, employment, or attainment of 21 years of age, whichever is earlier.

application form

text:

The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa-Unorganized Workers" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial benefits to Unorganized Workers (home-based, self-employed or wage workers).

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Unorganized Workers" is a Pension Scheme launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Unorganized Workers (home-based workers, self-employed workers or a wage workers) in the unorganized sector.

Eligibility:
The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.
The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.
The age of the applicant should be 55 years and above (except for ‘Greha Sahayika’).

NOTE:

Remarriage of a widow.
A member of the family of the beneficiary getting a Government Job.
The annual family income of the beneficiary exceeding ₹1,00,000/-, etc.

Benefits:
A pension amount of ₹2,000/- per month.

The sanctioned grant will be transferred directly to the individual bank account of the applicant.

title: Merit Cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme
text:
Brief Description:
It is the policy of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi that students get access to high quality higher education provided by Delhi State Universities irrespective of their caste, creed, economic background, or gender.

Detailed Description:
Detailed
Delhi Government wants to enhance access to high-quality higher education for meritorious economically disadvantaged sections of society. Many meritorious students from this section find it hard to bear the full tuition fee, though the better off sections of society do not face this difficulty. To ease the burden on such meritorious students, the Delhi Govt. proposes a Merit cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme for providing tuition fee reimbursement under the aegis of Delhi Higher Education Aid Trust, with the aim to enhance greater access to high-quality higher education for meritorious Students from econ0mically disadvantaged sections of the society. Many students from this section who find it hard to bear the full tuition fee will benefit immensely from the Scheme.
The Scheme is to extend financial assistance to the meritorious and needy students pursuing higher education in the NCT of Delhi. Under this Scheme the Delhi Higher Education Trust through the Directorate of Higher Education (DHE), GNCTD will fully or partially reimburse the tuition fee paid by the students.
The extent of reimbursement will be
(i)100% tuition fee of the meritorious students belonging to economically weaker section i.e. wards of parent/s who are beneficiaries and possess relevant cards issued under the National Food Security Security Scheme.
(ii) 50%of the tuition fee to meritorious students having annual family income up to ₹2.50 Lakh and not covered under the National Food Security Scheme.
(iii) 25% reimbursement of tuition fee to meritorious students having annual income above ₹2.50 Lakh but below ₹6 Lakh. It is anticipated that the Scheme will lead to the participation of meritorious economically weaker sections of society in gaining access to quality higher education of which they were deprived till now due to financial constraints. It will also help attract meritorious students to Delhi State Universities.

Eligibility:
The eligibility criteria for applying under this scheme shall be as follows:
(1) The student should have been enrolled on an undergraduate programme in any of the Delhi State Public Universities or colleges/ institutes affiliated with Delhi State Public Universities.
(2) The student should fulfil the income/ economic and academic performance criteria as specified for each category mentioned below

Qualifying Aggregate Percentage (Marks in All Subjects)
Percentage of Financial Assistance
Category 1: Beneficiary under National Food Security Scheme & possess the Card issued under the Scheme
60%
100%

60%
50%
Category 3: Family income above ₹2.50 Lakh p.a.but not exceeding ₹6 Lakh p.a
60%
25%
A relaxation of 5% in the qualifying aggregate percentage of marks will be allowed to SC/ST Category students.

Benefits:
Benefits
The extent of reimbursement will be
100% tuition fee of the meritorious students belonging to economically weaker section i.e. wards of parent/s who are beneficiaries and possess relevant cards issued under the National Food Security Scheme
50% of the tuition fee to meritorious students having annual family income.

title: NITI Internship Scheme
text:
Brief Description:
This Scheme seeks to engage students pursuing Under Graduate/Graduate/Post Graduate Degrees or are Research Scholars enrolled in recognized University/Institution within India or abroad, as "interns". They shall be given exposure to various Verticals/ Divisions/Units within NITI Aayog.

Detailed Description:
An Internship Scheme named "
NITI Internship Scheme
" seeks to engage students pursuing Under Graduate / Graduate / Post Graduate Degrees or are Research Scholars enrolled in recognized University/ Institution within India or abroad, as "
interns
". These 'interns" shall be given exposure to various Verticals/ Divisions/Units within NITI Aayog and would be expected to supplement the process of analysis within NITI Aayog through empirical collection and collation of in-house and other information. The internship will be on unpaid basis. This will allow short term exposure of "selected candidates" with the different Verticals/Divisions/Units of NITI Aayog, Government of India as 'Interns". Following are the domains/areas for which Internship is invited:-
Agriculture
Data Management and Analysis
Economics
Education/Human Resources Development
Energy Sector
Foreign Trade / Commerce
Governance
Health , Nutrition, Women & Child Development
Industry
Infrastructure connectivity
Mass Communications and Social Media
Mining Sector
Natural Resources, Environment & Forests
Programme Monitoring and Evaluation
Project appraisal and management.
Public Finances/Budget
Public Private Partnership
Rural Development and SDGs
Science and Technology
Skill Development & Employment
Social justice and empowerment
Sports and Youth development.
Tourism and culture
Urbanization / smart city.
Water Resources.
The period of Internship shall be at least six weeks but not exceeding six months. Interns will be required to have their own laptops. NITI Aayog shall provide them working space, internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads.
Objectives
The Scheme has the following objectives:
To allow young academic talent to be associated with the NITI Aayog's work for mutual benefit.
The "intern" shall have an opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Developmental Policy issues in Government of India and contribute to the Policy formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysis, briefing reports, policy papers, etc.

Eligibility:
Bonafide students of any recognized University/Institution within India or abroad, fulfilling following conditions are eligible to apply for the internship:-
Under-graduate students, having completed/appeared in the term end exams of second year/4
th
semester of the bachelor degree course and secured not less than 85% or equivalent marks in 12th class.
Graduate students having completed/ appeared in the term end exams of first year/2nd semester of their post graduate programme or pursuing research/PhD and secured not less than 70% or equivalent marks in Graduation.
The students who have appeared in the final exam or just completed Graduation/PG and waiting for admission for higher studies may also be considered for internship provided that:-
they have secured 70% or more cumulative marks in all the years/semesters of their graduation/post-graduation till the date of application.
The period between the month of declaration of result of final exam and the desired month of internship should not exceed six months e.g. if the result is declared in the month of June then he/she can apply for the internship beginning till the month of December.
NOTES:
The candidates need to apply 2 months in advance for the internship, and the application will be valid for the desired month only.
While doing the internship, the student must have an attendance of 75% to successfully complete the internship.
The time between the declaration of final exam results and the month of starting the internship should not be more than 6 months, this is applicable only to those who are applying after completing their studies.
The selected applicant has to produce original mark sheets and NOC from the college/institution at the time of joining, failing which his/her candidature shall be cancelled.

Benefits:
Experience Certificate/Internship Completion Certificate:
A certificate regarding successful completion of Internship shall be issued by the Adviser of the concerned Subject Division
Allows young academic talent to be associated with the NITI Aayog's work for mutual benefit.
Opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Developmental Policy issues in Government of India and contribute to the Policy formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysis, briefing reports, policy papers, etc.
NOTE:
Interns not completing the requisite period will not be issued any certificate.

Visit the official website i.e
https://workforindia.niti.gov.in/intern/InternshipEntry/PCInternshipEntry.aspx
After reading the instructions to fill the form. Fill all the details of the applicant.
In the field "Area of Interest", choose only one area of interest.
Click on Preview button to verify all details. On preview page check all entered details.
In case any correction is needed, click on Edit button.
If all fields are correct, submit button will appear for final submission of form. Then click Submit.
Applicant can check the status of his application on the link:
https://workforindia.niti.gov.in/intern/InternshipEntry/checkstatus.aspx
NOTES:
An applicant is eligible to apply for the internship only if he/she fulfils the minimum eligibility criteria mentioned in the guidelines.
Internship application will be accepted through ONLINE mode only during 1st (00:00 hrs) to 10th (23:59 hrs) of every month. No other mode of application is accepted.
One is advised to check the details before submission. No correspondence regarding change of details will be entertained.
Applicant should note Registration Number after submitting the application form for future reference.
NITI Aayog does not assume any responsibility if one is not being able to submit his/her application on account of technical reasons or any other reason beyond the control of NITI Aayog.
Applicant need not send the printout of ONLINE application or any other supporting documents.
Applicant should apply within 6 months from the month of declaration of the result of the final exam. For e.g. if the result is declared in June, then he/she can apply to begin the internship in December at the latest.
Indication of option does not reserve any right offering the same sector.
Allocation of the desired sector will be subject to availability and at the discretion of NITI Aayog.
